Home  Â»  Meetings Welcome to Coeur d'Alene Public Schools Home Calendar Meetings Search Meetings The Board of Trustees consists of five community members who volunteer their time and service to make decisions in the best interest of our schools and students. Board members are elected within their respective zones and serve four-year terms. The board selects the superintendent, sets district policies and budgets, approves educational programs, makes decisions about curriculum and textbook adoptions, and assures adherence to the district's strategic direction. Resources: Board of Trustees main page . Contact the Board   Meeting Archive Share Board of Trustees Regular Meeting Regular Board meetings take place once a month, generally on the second Monday of the month. It is the meeting where the Board takes care of district business. Click here to view the 2025 Regular Meeting Schedule. If auxiliary aids or services are needed to accommodate individuals with disabilities, please contact Marianne Southwick, Clerk of the Board, at (208) 664-8241 ext. 10007 or TTY/TDD at 1-800-377-3529 no later than 9:00 AM the day of the meeting.
